_about.note: Evidence category of every FoodBalance field (scripts/core/food_balance.gd) and every number in data/crops.json (Prompt 08, food part). Categories: balance (game tuning, no source; never a NASA figure), physics, S11 (NASA 'Growing Plants in Space': ISS Veggie grew lettuce; tomatoes only planned), S13 (NTRS VEG-04/05 flight definition, SEARCH-ONLY lead that VEG-05 was planned for tomato). Growing plants on the ISS does not prove that crops grow on Mars. Source ids refer to docs/source_register.md.

light_zone.note: "Greenhouse": the grow lights are the Greenhouse lighting circuit (9 kW in GameBalance.zone_load_kw). Game layout, not a NASA figure. Light factor 1 when switched on and not shed, else 0 (growth stops).

bed_water_capacity_l.note: 6 L of soil water per bed (or hydroponic tank).

water_good.note: 50 %: full growth speed at this soil water share or more; water factor = share / 0.5 below it, and the plants droop (wilting symptom).

water_low.note: 25 %: below it the colony warns that the bed is drying out.

drip_max_l_per_hour.note: 1 L per game hour through a clean drip line.

drip_clog_per_sol.note: 25 % of the flow lost per sol: the watering chore (flush by switching the bed's water on). Removed by food_irrigation_reliability; flushed daily by food_scheduled_care.

wilt_after_dry_hours.note: One sol (24.66 game hours) completely dry, then the plant wilts and must be replanted. An alert comes first.

nutrient_good_low.note: 40 %: bottom of the good band; below it yellow leaves and slower growth. No nutrient or fertilizer source has been checked (register section 10).

nutrient_good_high.note: 80 %: top of the good band (shown on panels).

nutrient_floor_factor.note: 15 % of full speed with no nutrients at all (slows, never instant death).

response_rise.note: The growth rate must rise 10 % over the rate at inspection to count as a response (food_observe_response).

trial_window_hours.note: One sol to see a response after the change.

schedule_l_per_bed_hour.note: 0.35 L per game hour per planted bed: what food_scheduled_care allocates if less is set.

schedule_flush_phase.note: Sol phase 0.3: the schedule flushes every drip line once per sol.

crops.lettuce.cycle_sols.note: 3 sols seed to harvest. TIME-COMPRESSED: weeks on Earth. Not a NASA figure.

crops.lettuce.meals.note: 5 meals per harvest (game abstraction of a food store counted in meals).

crops.lettuce.water_l_per_hour.note: 0.2 L per game hour from the soil.

crops.lettuce.nutrient_use_per_cycle.note: 60 % of the nutrient level used over a full cycle.

crops.lettuce.evidence.note: ISS analog evidence: lettuce was grown in Veggie (S11, VERIFIED). Space-station evidence, not Mars agriculture.

crops.tomato.cycle_sols.note: 6 sols seed to harvest. TIME-COMPRESSED: months on Earth. Not a NASA figure.

crops.tomato.water_l_per_hour.note: 0.3 L per game hour from the soil.

crops.tomato.nutrient_use_per_cycle.note: 90 % of the nutrient level used over a full cycle.

crops.tomato.evidence.note: Plan, not yet grown on the ISS: S11 lists tomatoes as future produce; S13 (SEARCH-ONLY) names a planned tomato flight. S14's 'Red Robin' lead is SEARCH-ONLY and not used. Not Mars evidence.

bed_water_source.note: Bed water is only taken from the greenhouse water LifeSupportModel delivered (ledger greenhouse_water_l); that water is already booked to wastewater, so no water is created and every ledger identity is unchanged.

meals_harvested.note: Ledger term: meals added to food_meals by harvest (food now = start + harvested - eaten - recovery).
